answer_1.quote: We evaluated our proposed framework KnowEE on four dialogue generation tasks: EMPATHETICDIALOGUES (ED), DAILYDIALOG (DD), PERSONA-CHAT (PC) and OPENDIALKG (ODKG).

answer_2.quote: We utilize Perplexity and DISTINCT to evaluate the models.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation on open-domain dialogue generation. We recruit university students to evaluate the quality of conversations. ... we employ several general metrics to evaluate the dialogue quality: Coherence, Informativeness, Fluency. Additionally, for ED we evaluate Empathy, for PC Personality, for DD Theme, and for ODKG Hallucination.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters scored each generated response according to the listed criteria.
